name: spriteflow
description: SpriteFlow - browser-only sprite pipeline tool (M1). Static site, zero server, hosted on Cloudflare Pages.

scripts.lint: biome check . && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && pnpm --filter @spriteflow/pipeline --if-present run build && pnpm --filter @spriteflow/pipeline run check:contract
scripts.golden: pnpm --filter @spriteflow/pipeline --if-present run build && pnpm --filter @spriteflow/golden --if-present run golden
scripts.build: pnpm -r --if-present run build && node scripts/check-licenses.mjs && node scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs
